english.meaning: in the pattern 越…越…, 'the more ... the more ...'
english.note: 越大越好 'the bigger the better'.

exampleSentences.english: I want to run, but I’m worried my legs will get thicker. Will they?
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想跑步啊，但係呢我驚呢越跑越粗啊對腳，會唔會𡃉？
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 paau2 bou6 aa3 daan6 hai6 ne1 ngo5 geng1 ne1 jyut6 paau2 jyut6 cou1 aa3 deoi3 goek3 wui5 m4 wui5 gaa3

exampleSentences.english: Is a bigger TV better for watching things?
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想問吓電視係唔係越大越好𡃉？睇嘢或者。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 din6 si6 hai6 m4 hai6 jyut6 daai6 jyut6 hou2 gaa3 tai2 je5 waak6 ze2
